product_metadata.title: Levtex Home - Serendipity - Window Panels with Rod Pocket - Two Curtains 84 inch Length - Mandalas - Orange, Turquoise, Green, Red, Citron, Yellow, Blue - 100% Cotton - Lined
features: LEVTEX HOME SERENDIPITY COLLECTION: The Serendipity curtain two panel set complements the Serendipity bedding collection but can be used to accessorize any window in your home. These window panels feature a vibrant collection of overlapping mandalas in fun colors and will complement so many design choices.

THE SERENDIPITY DESIGN: One of our most popular collections, Serendipity is inspired by a collection of bohemian mandalas. It is the perfect accessory for any bedroom, family room, living room or den.
CONVENIENT LUXURY: Made from 100% Cotton, the Serendipity drape panels are easy to care for. Two 84 inch long drape panels included in purchase (55 inches wide).

COORDINATE YOUR HOME: Create a wonderful space with our coordinated Serendipity Collection. The design is versatile and will match a variety of different looks. You can also freshen your room with other items from the Levtex Home Collection.
